items.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

items.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
items.summary: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

items.title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
items.summary: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

items.summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Senator Bill Hagerty: Expanding the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, & the Future of Dollar Hegemony Sen. Bill Hagerty explains why CBDCs threaten freedom, how regulatory ambiguity enabled SEC overreach

items.title: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
items.summary: The ratings agency cited RLUSD's Treasury-heavy reserves, but noted that holders have no direct ownership interest in them for now.
